title: Summer Dress U-neck Short-sleeve Loose Casual Pure Color Full-skirted Long Dress
body_html:
1. Classic U-neck design modifies neck line, elegant and not too revealing; short sleeve design keeps you cool in hot summer.
  2. Loose fit hides belly fat and hip flaws, friendly to all body shapes.
  3. Big swing hem flows gracefully while walking, modifies body proportion visually.
  4. Plain solid color design, simple and versatile, easy to match with shoes and bags.
  5. Lightweight breathable fabric, ideal for daily wear, shopping, travel and casual occasions.
